purpose: Blueprint 2026-09-08 �34: every state-changing API route classified by the credential it accepts, so the CSRF posture of the surface is a checked-in fact rather than a re-derived opinion. lib/route-classification.test.ts fails when a route gains a state-changing method without an entry here, when an entry names a file that no longer exists, or when a route's methods drift from what is recorded.

legend.A-bearer: Privilege comes only from an Authorization: Bearer header. A cross-site request cannot attach one ambiently, so classic browser CSRF does not reach it. Requires: no wildcard credentialed CORS origin.
legend.B-cookie: Privilege comes from an ambient cookie or session. Requires SameSite policy plus Origin/Referer validation or an anti-CSRF token. NO ROUTE IN THIS REPOSITORY IS TYPE B; adding one without an origin guard fails the test.
legend.C-webhook: Privilege comes from a signature over the raw request body. Requires raw-body verification, a replay window, and event dedupe.
legend.E-signed-service: Bodyless service request signed over method, fixed path/audience, timestamp and request ID. Requires body refusal, durable replay prevention and issuance budget; no cookie authority.
legend.D-oauth-callback: Provider redirect. Requires state, PKCE, and a fixed redirect policy.
legend.P-public: Accepts no credential and grants no tenant privilege. Nothing exists for a forged request to ride, so origin checks here are anti-abuse, not CSRF defence.
legend.F-oauth-token: TAVONEL as the OAuth 2.1 authorization server of the remote MCP. The credential is an authorization code in the form body, sealed to one client and bound to a PKCE S256 verifier, so nothing ambient exists for a forged request to ride. Requires: single-use code, PKCE, exact redirect binding.

corsPosture: No route sets any Access-Control-Allow-* header, and next.config.mjs adds none. There is therefore no credentialed cross-origin access and no wildcard origin anywhere on the API surface. lib/route-classification.test.ts asserts this.
cookies: The API surface sets two cookies. The first is the self-service trial device cookie (lib/self-service-trial.ts:69, HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax). It is an abuse signal consumed by bootstrap_foundation_self_service_trial, never an authorization credential: app/api/access/bootstrap/route.ts rejects the request with AUTH_REQUIRED before reading it unless a Bearer JWT is present. The second is the acting-workspace cookie `tavonel_ws` (app/api/workspaces/select/route.ts, HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; 30 days, WO-C-T1). It selects among the caller's own active workspace memberships and grants nothing: lib/acting-workspace.ts honours it only after a Bearer JWT authenticated the request and only while the user holds an active foundation_workspace_members row for the named workspace, re-read on every request; otherwise the user's own workspace. Privilege still comes only from the Bearer header. Billing and access bootstrap never read it.

app/api/access/bootstrap/route.ts.note: Sets the trial device cookie, but requires the Bearer JWT first.

app/api/account/test-reset/route.ts.note: Destructive founder-only two-phase reset. Requires the exact founder email, active workspace owner membership, reset id, and a dry-run manifest digest; database assertions repeat identity, ownership, legal-hold, and active-work checks.

app/api/agent-grants/[id]/route.ts.note: WO-AN-3 Disconnect. Session only (a tvnl_agt_ bearer is not a JWT: AUTH_REQUIRED); never behind the flag, never plan-gated. Revokes the caller's own grant, its credential and its open proposals in one transaction; any other id is the same 404.

app/api/agent-grants/[id]/activity/route.note: WO-AN-10 per-grant activity. Session only; never behind the flag, never plan-gated. Only the person who made the grant reads it (any other id is the same 404). Rows carry type, state, times and whether a signed receipt exists; no preview, document id, principal or digest. ?format=ndjson answers the same page as a download.

app/api/agent-grants/route.ts.note: WO-AN-3 Agent access. GET lists the caller's own grants (no token, hash or prefix), flag off included. POST is 404 with the flag off or outside the cohort, 402 for a free evaluation, and answers the tvnl_agt_ token once, no-store; only its sha256 is stored.

app/api/agent-mcp/route.ts.note: agent credential only; 404 while TAVONEL_AGENT_PROPOSALS_ENABLED is off

app/api/billing/refund-request/route.ts.note: Pages an operator with a refund request. Calls no Paddle refund or adjustment API.

app/api/contact/route.ts.note: Same-origin allowlist, application/json only, 16KB cap, honeypot, per-process IP+domain rate limit. Durable limit blocked on a migration; see the ponytail note in the route.

app/api/csp-report/route.ts.note: CSP Report-Only collector (trust lane). Unauthenticated by design: 8KB declared+actual cap, at most 8 reports per POST, only four sanitized fields logged, never the body. Edge rate limit is backlog with the other public endpoints.

app/api/documents/[id]/lifecycle/route.t.note: POST refuses API keys (session only) and non owner/admin roles. Execute must echo the dry-run manifest digest; the tombstone RPC repeats membership, ownership and legal-hold checks under the hold lock. Workspace is the principal's, never a request field.

app/api/internal/billing/settle/route.ts.note: lib/compute-settlement-auth.ts: digest over the raw body, 300s timestamp window, request id.

app/api/internal/cdr/identity/route.ts.note: Body forbidden; domain-separated method/path/audience/timestamp/UUID signature, 60s window, durable replay and issuance limit. No cookie authority; disabled by default and outside production.

app/api/internal/change-notify/run/route.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET through the shared constant-time helper, closed when unset. Cross-tenant by design; answers CHANGE_NOTIFY_DISABLED and reads nothing while TAVONEL_CHANGE_NOTIFY_ENABLED is unset.

app/api/internal/deletions/attest/route..note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. Lists and hashes only exact source-owned R2 prefixes and records an append-only inventory attestation; it does not delete bytes.

app/api/internal/deletions/retention/rou.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. POST dry_run lists candidates and writes nothing. POST execute with one workspaceKey (the canary) must echo the dry run's candidatesSha256; fleet execute is refused unless FOUNDATION_RETENTION_FLEET_ARMED is exactly "true". GET is the scheduled fleet run: refused unless that same variable is exactly "true" (checked before any database read), replies with counts and the batch digest only. Records at most 25 retention_expired tombstones per request, one transaction each, skipping any workspace whose legal hold is not readably inactive; deletes no bytes.

app/api/internal/deletions/run/route.ts.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. Cross-tenant by design; advances at most one legal-hold-cleared source object per invocation.

app/api/internal/jobs/acl-refresh/route..note: isInternalWorkerAuthorized requires a Bearer FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET or CRON_SECRET configured with at least 32 characters before the bounded ACL refresh turn. Cross-tenant infrastructure worker; no cookie authority.

app/api/internal/jobs/run/route.ts.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. Cross-tenant by design; never reachable with a customer credential.

app/api/internal/model-provider/reconcil.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. POST only and deliberately no GET: the actual units come off a provider invoice a person read, so this must not be schedulable. Resolves one pending_reconciliation reservation; refuses unknown, already-settled and conflicting ones, and replays idempotently.

app/api/internal/probe/route.ts.note: Same two secrets and the same constant-time compare as the jobs cron, closed when unset. Writes only synthetic/probe/history.json under the synthetic prefix; reads no tenant data.

app/api/internal/sli-alerts/route.ts.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. Reads bounded synthetic probe history and writes append-only operational SLI evaluation receipts; reads no tenant data.

app/api/internal/remote-mcp/revoke-all/r.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. W1-A1 rollback lever: revokes every live remote MCP key (token_kind mcp) in one write; returns counts per workspace, no key material.

app/api/internal/agent-grants/revoke-all.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. WO-AN-3 kill switch: revokes every agent grant and tvnl_agt_ credential and withdraws every open agent proposal in one transaction, one audit row per credential; live and remote MCP keys untouched; returns counts per workspace, no key material.

app/api/library/decisions/route.ts.note: Session only: an API key is refused with 403 even with scopes. A person's decision on a Library label; appends one row, deletes nothing.

app/api/operations/p0/admission/route.ts.note: planLargeDocumentAdmission is a pure policy calculator: no read, no write, no tenant data. 4KB body cap. Unauthenticated compute; edge rate limit is backlog.

app/api/paddle/webhook/route.ts.note: lib/paddle-webhook.ts: HMAC over `ts:rawBody`, 300s window; dedupe by p_event_id in lib/billing-store.ts.

app/api/proof-pdf/route.ts.note: GET only, and state-changing in neither shape nor effect: it re-fetches one fixed public W3C fixture and refuses it unless the bytes hash to a pinned sha256. It accepts no URL, no id and no customer input, so it reaches no tenant data. Listed because the inventory is a checked-in fact only if the routes that are deliberately public appear in it alongside the ones that are not.

app/api/proposals/route.ts.note: Session only: an API key is refused with 403. POST creates a proposal and mutates nothing else; needs an Idempotency-Key header.

app/api/proposals/[id]/route.ts.note: Session only: the inbox deep link. Unreadable, foreign, absent, malformed and unknown-type ids are the same 404 body.

app/api/proposals/[id]/receipt/route.ts.note: WO-AN-10 signed receipt download. Session only: an API key or agent credential is refused. Answers only the stored signed receipt (verifies offline); absent, foreign, unreadable, malformed and unsigned ids are the same 404 body.

app/api/proposals/[id]/decision/route.ts.note: Session only: no API key or MCP path can confirm. Confirm executes once through the executor map; stale and expired never execute.

app/api/proposals/[id]/undo/route.ts.note: Session only. Undo of an executed proposal: the opposite library decision, recorded as undone.

app/api/research-updates/route.ts.note: Research Updates opt-in (M-05). Shared origin allowlist (lib/public-form-origin.ts), application/json only, 4KB cap, honeypot, closed-shape parse. Stores nothing and answers 503 on every path: the table and the privacy wording are founder items, and no form on the site points here. Its rate limit is the RPC the contact route is blocked on, and having one is a precondition of enabling it.

app/api/uploads/approval/cancel/route.ts.note: Cancels the caller's complete approved intake set and releases remaining reserved member holds; the attempt, scope and member identity anchor are revalidated against the stored approval.

app/api/uploads/approval/route.ts.note: POST recomputes the quote and pricing fingerprint and atomically records one approval for the exact complete manifest, or refuses a changed price. GET is read-only reconciliation by attemptKey within the caller's workspace.

app/api/v1/collections/[id]/retrieval-in.note: Rebuilds the derived retrieval index for the ACTIVE world only; the manifest comes from the active pointer, not the request. Takes collections:compile plus the owner/admin role, the same bar promotion takes. Promotes nothing and changes no knowledge.

app/api/v1/oauth-connectors/authorize/ro.note: Mints the state + PKCE verifier consumed by the callback.

app/api/v1/oauth-connectors/callback/[pr.note: State is single-use and consumed by hash (consumeOAuthAuthorization), PKCE verifier is read from the secret broker, and the redirect URI must equal the runtime-configured one. GET, so it is not a state-changing method by shape, but it is state-changing in effect and is classified deliberately.

app/api/v1/oauth-connectors/viewer-links.note: requireFoundationSession with studio plan authenticates the Bearer session before revoking Google Drive viewer principals for that workspace, user and authorization revision. No cookie authority.

app/api/v1/uploads/approval/cancel/route.note: Re-export; delegates caller, scope and whole-set cancellation checks to the unversioned handler.

app/api/v1/uploads/confirm/route.ts.note: Re-export; the unversioned confirmation revalidates the caller's approval and stored object before atomically confirming.

app/api/v1/uploads/quote/route.ts.note: No-hold quote: validates and prices the whole manifest and writes nothing -- no approval, admission reservation or compute ledger entry. Bounded by MAX_APPROVAL_METADATA_BYTES.

app/api/v1/uploads/triage/complete/route.note: Requires documents:intake Bearer authorization, customer-data admission and the triage rollout gate before claiming and sealing a staged source. The seal claim is bound to workspace, actor, stage, preflight approval and seal token; the returned sealed identity is checked.

app/api/v1/uploads/triage/preflight/rout.note: Requires documents:intake Bearer authorization, customer-data admission and the triage rollout gate before creating workspace- and actor-bound whole-batch preflight approval. File count and declared bytes only; no OCR, parsing or compile authority.

app/api/v1/uploads/triage/receipt/route..note: Requires documents:intake Bearer authorization, customer-data admission and the triage rollout gate before creating the triage receipt. Staged rows must match workspace, actor and preflight approval; every preflight member must be sealed and the complete include/exclude choices are checked.

app/api/v1/uploads/triage/stage/route.ts.note: Requires documents:intake Bearer authorization, customer-data admission and the triage rollout gate before recording a workspace- and actor-bound batch member and issuing its bounded staging PUT capability. Validates the returned stage identity, quarantine path and expiry. No cookie authority.

app/api/workspace-invites/accept/route.t.note: Accepts an invite token only after authenticating the target user, then revalidates the resulting membership.

app/api/workspaces/[workspaceKey]/member.note: WO-C-T3 member source scope. Owner/admin only (requireWorkspaceMembership), repeated in set_member_source_scope; PUT needs an Idempotency-Key and replaces the scope, effective on the member's next request.

app/api/workspaces/select/route.ts.note: Sets the acting-workspace cookie tavonel_ws only after the Bearer JWT is authenticated and an active membership in the named workspace is read; choosing one's own workspace clears it. The cookie selects among the caller's own memberships; privilege still comes only from the Bearer header.

app/api/workspaces/mine/route.ts.note: Lists the caller's own active workspace memberships and which one the request acts in, with each workspace's owner display name (the name only: never the owner's user id, email or other metadata; read server-side from Supabase Auth with the service role). The cookie selects among the caller's own memberships; privilege still comes only from the Bearer header.

app/api/access/processing-terms/route.ts.note: Records owner processing-terms acceptance only; grants nothing.

app/api/internal/billing/gate-enforce/ro.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, closed when unset. Cross-tenant scheduled enforcement verifies provider identity and signed workspace binding before pausing a subscription whose processing admission is unavailable.

app/api/mcp/route.ts.note: Remote MCP (G11), 404 while TAVONEL_REMOTE_MCP_ENABLED is off. Read-only tool table from the stdio bridge; tools/call needs a read-only developer key, initialize and tools/list answer without one. A present Origin must equal the server's own.

app/api/mcp/oauth/authorize/route.ts.note: Remote MCP consent (G11), 404 while off. describe and deny take no credential and grant nothing; approve issues a code only for a Supabase bearer that requireFoundationSession accepts and that is not a free evaluation.

app/api/mcp/oauth/register/route.ts.note: RFC 7591 registration for the remote MCP (G11), 404 while off. Stateless sealed client id; writes nothing and grants nothing until a person consents.

app/api/mcp/oauth/token/route.ts.note: Remote MCP token endpoint (G11), 404 while off. Mints a developer key holding only the granted read scopes, expiring with the token, through the authorization-revision-checked key RPC.

memberScope.purpose: WO-C-T3: every API route, by how a workspace member's source scope reaches it. A member reads a World only when every source behind it is in their scope (TC-D2); lists drop what a member cannot read and never return its count, title or id. lib/route-classification.test.ts fails when a route is in none of the three maps or in two, when an entry names a file that no longer exists, or when an enforced route's file does not contain the mechanism its entry names.
